answer: Use continuous VDF leases: an onyx registry admitting only identities with fresh sequential-work proofs. 1) A random beacon supplies an anchor for a challenge tied to the applicant’s key. 2) The applicant computes that challenge for 48 hours, posting hourly checkpoints. 3) Anyone verifies the proof cheaply; renewal requires a new challenge daily, so one proof cannot spawn clones. 1,000 Sybils need 1,000 CPU cores for 48 hours: 48,000 core-hours, or $1,920 at $0.04 each, before any reward.
